data.original_title: The Guest in the Front Room
data.overview: A newly pregnant woman tries to settle into a home shared with her husband's unnervingly controlling mother. As the older woman's attention turns toward the unborn child, the young couple must decide how far they will let her intrude.
data.title: The Guest in the Front Room
